population: best_tier==professional AND has an ORCID-sourced candidate in harvest/authors/links.json (141 people -- close to but not exactly the queue-stated 158; the exact count depends on the precise definition of "best candidate is an orcid.org record", and links.json has been evolving under concurrent sessions).
method: For each person: (1) fetched their ORCID public record (pub.orcid.org) for employment history + researcher-urls, mechanically, free; (2) any non-social-media researcher-url was WebFetched to verify liveness + identity; (3) otherwise WebSearched using ORCID employment / OpenAlex affiliation / our own authors.json latest_affiliation as institution context, plus paper-topic cross-checking. Never accepted a candidate on name alone; never touched LinkedIn as a source.
